# Valkyrian Labs Documentation

Valkyrian Labs publishes Payload CMS and Markdown tooling documentation for
developers and AI agents.

Main docs:

- Payload Markdown Docs: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs
- Payload Markdown: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown

Native agent skills:

- Payload Markdown Docs Codex skill: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/codex/SKILL.md
- Payload Markdown Docs Claude skill: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/claude/SKILL.md
- Payload Markdown Codex skill: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown/skills/codex/SKILL.md
- Payload Markdown Claude skill: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown/skills/claude/SKILL.md

Agents should prefer native skills over scraping rendered directive-heavy docs
pages. Use rendered docs for human-facing product reference, and use skill
artifacts for agent workflow rules.
